headlines.description: Denver quarterback Brock Osweiler ran for one touchdown and threw for two more Thursday night to lead the Broncos past Indianapolis 25-13.
headlines.shortLinkText: Osweiler's strong relief appearance leads Broncos past Colts

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford threw two touchdown passes and avoided mistakes, allowing the Detroit Lions to stay in the playoff picture with a 20-10 victory over the Chicago Bears on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford-led Lions beat Bears 20-10, stay in playoff picture

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Alex Smith threw for 231 yards and two touchdowns, Kareem Hunt ran for 155 yards and a score, and the Kansas City Chiefs routed the turnover-prone Los Angeles Chargers 30-13 on Saturday night to seize control of the AFC West.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs rout Chargers 30-13 to seize control of AFC West race

headlines.description: LeSean McCoy scored twice and surpassed 10,000 career-yards rushing, while helping the Buffalo Bills stay in the thick of the AFC playoff hunt with a 24-16 win over the Miami Dolphins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCoy breaks 10,000, leads Bills to 24-16 win over Dolphins

headlines.description: Joe Flacco threw a touchdown pass, ran for a score and beat Cleveland again as the Baltimore Ravens stayed on track for the AFC playoffs with a 27-10 win Sunday over the Browns, now two losses from becoming the NFL's second 0-16 team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens stay in playoff picture, down winless Browns 27-10

headlines.description: Eric Kendricks had an interception return for a touchdown, Case Keenum passed for 236 yards and two scores, and the Minnesota Vikings clinched the NFC North title with a 34-7 victory over the depleted and disinterested Cincinnati Bengals on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings cruise past Bengals 34-7 to clinch NFC North

events.name: New York Jets at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Mark Ingram ran for two touchdowns and gained 151 yards from scrimmage, including a late 50-yard TD run, and the New Orleans Saints overcame three turnovers to defeat the struggling New York Jets, 31-19 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ingram, Thomas lift Saints over Jets, 31-19

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at New York Giants

headlines.description: Nick Foles threw four touchdown passes in his first start replacing the injured Carson Wentz, and the Philadelphia Eagles secured a first-round playoff bye, rallying from an early 14-point deficit to defeat the surprising New York Giants 34-29 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Foles throws 4 TDs, Eagles get first-round bye

headlines.description: Anthony Lanier sacked Blaine Gabbert and forced a fumble that Preston Smith recovered and the Washington Redskins held on to beat the Arizona Cardinals 20-15 Sunday in a game that was a comedy of errors for each team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Smith, Lanier handle Gabbert; Redskins beat Cardinals 20-15

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw for 242 yards and four touchdowns, and the Carolina Panthers spoiled Aaron Rodgers' return from a broken collarbone with a 31-24 win over the Green Bay Packers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton throws 4 TDs, Panthers spoil Rodgers' return 31-24

headlines.description: The Jacksonville Jaguars are returning to the playoffs for the first time in a decade thanks to a 45-7 drubbing of rival Houston on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaguars thump Texans 45-7 for 1st playoff berth since 2007

events.name: Los Angeles Rams at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: Todd Gurley rushed for 152 yards and scored four total touchdowns in just 2 1/2 quarters, and the Los Angeles Rams moved to the cusp of their first division title since 2003 with a 42-7 thumping of the Seattle Seahawks on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams Rules: LA rout Seattle 42-7 for control of division

events.name: New England Patriots at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: Tom Brady and Rob Gronkowski did it to the Pittsburgh Steelers again.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots rally behind Gronkowski, edge Steelers 27-24

headlines.description: Jimmy Garoppolo led one final scoring drive in the closing seconds to cap a fantastic first home start, Robbie Gould kicked a game-winning 45-yard field goal as time expired, and the San Francisco 49ers topped the Tennessee Titans 25-23 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jimmy Time! Garoppolo leads 49ers to third straight win

headlines.description: Dallas kept its playoff hopes alive by the slimmest of margins after Dak Prescott converted a fourth-down sneak by the width of an index card to set up Dan Bailey's go-ahead 19-yard field goal, and Derek Carr fumbled the ball inches from the goal line...
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys edge Raiders 20-17 by slimmest of margins

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Devonta Freeman rushed for 126 yards and a touchdown to help the Atlanta Falcons stay close in the tight NFC South race with a 24-21 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Freeman runs for 126 yards, Falcons hold off Bucs 24-21
